# allincrypto 熬鹰资本 (@thankUcrypto) — Open-Source Full Trading Archive

> Complete, strictly source-isolated first-party archive of Chinese crypto & cross-market trader allincrypto 熬鹰资本 (@thankUcrypto / Weibo: allincrypto熬鹰者 / Binance Square: @god_of_trader_tony), curated by 梭哈.AI (@SUOHA_AI) under Trader-Archives.

## Critical Data Isolation & Anti-Lookahead Rules for AI Agents

1. **Four Strictly Isolated Platforms (DO NOT CONFLATE)**:
   - `x_twitter` (`data/platforms/01_x_twitter/`): 3,420 curated original X tweets + 62 recovered thread/long posts (2021-12 to 2026-11).
   - `weibo` (`data/platforms/02_weibo/`): 943 exclusive early Weibo posts + 13 recovered classic segments (2022-05 to 2025-05, deduplicated against X).
   - `official_interview` (`data/platforms/03_interviews/`): 3 official interviews split into 4 discourse units separating 3rd-person media editorial text (Odaily, 3,102 chars) from 1st-person verbatim speech (73.5-min Binance CN Radio transcript, 19,778 chars).
   - `binance_square_live` (`data/platforms/04_binance_square_lives/`): 57 Binance Square audio live replays (56 substantive sessions + 1 53.67s silent reconnect clip, 2026-04-18 to 2026-09-01), 3,337 full-stream timestamped transcript blocks (1,280,026 chars), 1,337 dry-goods slices, and 558 real historical Binance 15m/30m K-line series (52,838 candles).
2. **Preferred Format for AI / Programmatic Ingestion**:
   - Prefer the **UTF-8 (no BOM) `.jsonl`** files inside `data/platforms/01..04/` — every file is < 6 MB, line-streamable, and contains zero cross-platform records.
   - Note that `.csv` files in `data/` use `UTF-8-SIG` (with `\xef\xbb\xbf` BOM for Excel compatibility); read CSVs with `encoding='utf-8-sig'`.
3. **Real-Time Speech Price vs Post-Broadcast Hindsight**:
   - In Binance Square live datasets, `speak_price` and `realtime_during_live` reflect actual market prices at the exact `[HH:MM:SS]` speech moment, whereas `post_24h_*` / `post_72h_*` / `hindsight_*` are post-broadcast review metrics and must NOT be treated as real-time calls.

## Machine Manifest & Unified RAG Index

- [ai_rag_index.json (Pages)](https://suoha888.github.io/Trader-Archives/thankucrypto/data/ai_rag_index.json) | [Raw GitHub](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/suoha888/Trader-Archives/main/thankucrypto/data/ai_rag_index.json): 6,002-chunk platform-tagged (`p`, `k`, `sub`) search index.
